user_stories.title: Create wf_case_sup supervisor module
acceptance_criteria: Module compiles without errors
Exports start_link/0, start_case/3, stop_case/1, stop_case/2, list_cases/0, find_case/1, get_case_status/1, case_count/0
init/1 returns proper supervisor flags with simple_one_for_one strategy, intensity 10, period 60
Child spec template points to wf_case_runner with temporary restart
Dialyzer passes with no warnings
Doctests validate module structure
user_stories.notes: Core supervisor infrastructure following pattern from yawl_workflow_supervisor:84-98

user_stories.title: Create wf_case_runner gen_server wrapper
acceptance_criteria: Module compiles without errors
Implements gen_server behavior with init/1, handle_call/3, handle_cast/2, handle_info/2, terminate/2, code_change/3
Exports start_link/3, get_info/1, cancel/1
State record includes case_id, spec_id, case_type, status, workflow_pid, started_at, completed_at, data, options
Registers case with gproc using {wf_case, CaseId} key
Supports gen_yawl workflow type (initially)
Handles workflow process EXIT messages
Unregisters from gproc in terminate/2
Generates unique case IDs using crypto:hash
Dialyzer passes with no warnings
user_stories.notes: Case runner isolates workflow execution from supervision concerns. Pattern from active_token_sup.erl

user_stories.title: Integrate wf_case_sup into cre_sup
acceptance_criteria: wf_case_sup child spec added to cre_sup init/1
Child spec uses permanent restart and infinity shutdown
wf_case_sup appears in supervisor:which_children(cre_sup)
cre_sup doctest updated to expect 9 children (7 workers, 3 supervisors)
All existing doctests pass
CRE application starts successfully with new supervisor
All existing services (cre_master, yawl_timeout, etc.) still running after start
user_stories.notes: Add child spec after yawl_workflow_supervisor (line 266), following pattern from cre_sup.erl:259-266
